title: What is Structured output, and what problem does it solve?

cues.en: In previous lectures, I have hinted at something called Structured Output and it's finally time to learn about it.
cues.zh: 前面幾堂課提過結構化輸出，現在終於要正式學習了。

cues.en: The best way to learn about Structured Output is to see the problem that we will face and then see how we fix it with Structured Output.
cues.zh: 理解結構化輸出的最好方式，是先看看會遇到什麼問題，再看它如何解決。

cues.en: So in this case, I have a normal client and a normal agent and this agent have given the instructions that it's a movie expert.
cues.zh: 這裡有一般的用戶端和代理程式，並在指示中設定它是電影專家。

cues.en: So I want to give it the question, list the top three best movies according to IMDB, which is a website for movies if you don't know them.
cues.zh: 我要問：「依照 IMDb，列出評價最高的三部電影。」如果你不熟悉，IMDb 是電影資訊網站。

cues.en: And if we do this normally, we can certainly get a message back.
cues.zh: 一般這樣問，當然可以得到文字回應。

cues.en: And what we got back here in this case, let's give it a little more room, is that we got back the Shawshank Redemption.
cues.zh: 這次回傳的結果；把畫面放大一點，可以看到第一部是《刺激1995》。

cues.en: We got as of October 23 and we had some things about it being fluctuating because of course it could have changed since it hasn't.
cues.zh: 它說資料截至 2023 年 10 月，並提醒排名可能變動，因為理論上資訊可能已更新，雖然這次沒有。

cues.en: And it chose to give us back a 1-2-3 in Markdown where they put the year in here and it gave the
cues.zh: 它選擇用 Markdown 的一、二、三條列，裡面放上映年份，也附上

cues.en: IMDB rating as well.
cues.zh: IMDb 評分。

cues.en: So this might be good enough for a chatbot because this is nice, but only if we wanted to make a website where we
cues.zh: 對聊天機器人來說，這樣可能已經很好。但如果要製作網站，

cues.en: listed those three movies and put the rating in a specific field, the year in a specific field and so on, we would need to sit and pass this text.
cues.zh: 把三部電影列出來，評分放進評分欄位、年份放進年份欄位，就得另外解析這段文字。

cues.en: And we could do that, but then something like this will happen if we ask again.
cues.zh: 確實可以解析，但再問一次，可能就會發生這種情況。

cues.en: We get it slightly in a different manner.
cues.zh: 這次回傳格式稍有不同。

cues.en: This time it's still using Markdown, still using 1-2-3, but instead of the rating, it thought it was best to give back
cues.zh: 仍然是 Markdown，也仍然是一、二、三，但它覺得不提供評分，改成提供

cues.en: the genre of the movie.
cues.zh: 電影類型比較好。

cues.en: So this is non-deterministic.
cues.zh: 這就是非決定性。

cues.en: Every time we ask, we might get a different scenario.
cues.zh: 每次問，都可能得到不同的形式。

cues.en: Sometimes it will give back rating, sometimes the genre, sometimes the director, sometimes it's Markdown, sometimes it's not, sometimes it's a list, sometimes it's
cues.zh: 有時有評分，有時有類型，有時有導演；有時用 Markdown，有時不用；有時是清單，有時

cues.en: not.
cues.zh: 又不是。

cues.en: So we would be probably worse off with an AI trying to pass this because we can't just live with text.
cues.zh: 如果只能處理純文字，就很難可靠地解析 AI 回應。

cues.en: So for that reason, we have structured output.
cues.zh: 因此我們需要結構化輸出。

cues.en: So structured output is essentially just calling RunAsync like we did before, but telling we want
cues.zh: 本質上，一樣是呼叫 RunAsync，只是告訴它，我們想要

cues.en: it like this.
cues.zh: 這樣的結果。

cues.en: So what we have here is a movie result.
cues.zh: 這裡定義一個 MovieResult，

cues.en: This is just a class, and inside it, it has a list of movies.
cues.zh: 它只是一般類別，裡面包含一個電影清單。

cues.en: And these movies are the title of the movie, director, the year of release, and the IMDb score, which is none of these gave it back.
cues.zh: 每部電影有標題、導演、上映年份和 IMDb 分數；剛才兩次回應都沒有把這些全部給齊。

cues.en: And of course, we could have tried to write in our description, not that it's only an expert.
cues.zh: 當然，也可以把指示寫得更完整，不只說它是專家，

cues.en: We could have said, we always want to have this, this, and this information about each language, but we will still need to pass text.
cues.zh: 還要求每部電影一律提供這些資訊，但最後仍然需要解析文字。

cues.en: But doing it like this, we will instead, when we run Async here, we would get a response back, which essentially is JSON.
cues.zh: 改成這個方式，RunAsync 回傳的內容，本質上就是 JSON。

cues.en: And now we have full control over how things look because what happened here was that
cues.zh: 現在我們能完整控制資料格式，因為實際發生的是，

cues.en: beside our question we sent, we also sent a JSON schema on how we want it back.
cues.zh: 除了問題之外，也一併傳送描述回傳格式的 JSON Schema。

cues.en: So agent framework is really nice at just giving us this object and turning it into
cues.zh: Agent Framework 很方便，能直接根據這個物件產生

cues.en: a schema, having these fields, and saying we can get it back.
cues.zh: 包含這些欄位的結構描述，並要求模型依照它回傳。

cues.en: And we get it back as JSON.
cues.zh: 最後就得到 JSON。

cues.en: We even get it back with a dot result here because the new response is a chat client agent response of type movie result.
cues.zh: 甚至可以直接讀取 Result，因為回應現在是 MovieResult 泛型的 ChatClientAgentResponse。

cues.en: So now we get our result, so we can simply inspect it like any other .NET object, and we get our data back.
cues.zh: 拿到 Result 後，就能像操作其他 .NET 物件一樣，直接檢查和使用資料。

cues.en: In this case, I'm printing it out in format here, but of course, we could send
cues.zh: 這裡只是格式化後輸出，但當然也能把

cues.en: this result back, send it over the wire, use it in a HTML GUI, or whatever we need to do.
cues.zh: 結果回傳、經由網路傳送，或用在 HTML 介面，依照需求處理。

cues.en: So we can also see the raw JSON, and this is the power of structured output
cues.zh: 也能查看原始 JSON。這就是結構化輸出的力量，

cues.en: because unless you're doing chatbots, this is what you want like 95% of the time.
cues.zh: 因為除非在做聊天機器人，否則大約 95% 的時候，你真正想要的就是這種資料。

cues.en: So this is very, very powerful, and we can use these objects throughout how we want.
cues.zh: 它非常強大，產生的物件也能在系統裡自由運用。

cues.en: It costs a little extra tokens.
cues.zh: 代價是會多用一些 Token。

cues.en: I didn't show the token count, but because we need to send a schema on how the object looks like, it will cost more tokens.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有展示數量，但因為必須把物件的結構描述一起傳送，所以會增加輸入 Token。

cues.en: It will take a little longer, but it is definitely worth it, and this is my favourite feature of any LLM that we can
cues.zh: 也會多花一點時間，但絕對值得。這是我最喜歡的 LLM 功能，

cues.en: do structured outputs.
cues.zh: 也就是結構化輸出。
